body.purpose: Self-hosted Heebo 400, 500, 600 and 700; the final app family, separate from email typography.

headline.purpose: Bold 1.45rem page titles; 1.3rem at 760px and below, with normal Hebrew letter spacing.

title.purpose: Medium-bold .96rem panel headings with a quiet action or hint.

metric.purpose: Medium-bold 2rem summary values across widths. Page-insight values remain 1.3rem.

label.purpose: Medium-weight .8rem summary labels; secondary source timestamps stay quiet and compact.

field-label.purpose: Medium-weight form and login labels in ink.

action.purpose: Medium-weight button text with a 44px minimum target.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Date and site menus above the current workspace.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The structural edge of a blocking drawer.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Existing button and navigation state feedback; disabled under reduced motion. No decorative animation.

authentication.setup: Numbered phone/QR/code sequence; locally generated black-on-white QR with quiet zone; native disclosures for download and same-phone manual key
authentication.signin: Centered six-digit numeric input, matching account and separate backup-code alternative
authentication.recovery: Explicit backup saving with copy/download; clear QR and setup key after enrollment
authentication.constraints: Mandatory TOTP retained; no remote QR service, secret links, persistent browser keys or existing-seed replacement

narrative.overview:
A compact daily workbench makes website activity, client work, shared credentials and server attention easy to scan. Porcelain canvas, white data surfaces, slate navigation and petrol actions put aligned numbers and useful controls first. Domain context, measured summaries and short contextual actions support a daily check; longer explanations open on demand.

Website activity, client follow-up, the team vault, services, settings and authentication share the light system. Infrastructure uses graphite surfaces with the same components, density and interaction grammar. The vault has one desktop list/detail workspace and separate mobile views; its approved [desktop composition](.impeccable/mocks/vault-desktop.png) and [approval record](.impeccable/mocks/vault-desktop.json) establish spatial direction, while semantic Hebrew and functional controls follow the implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Hebrew RTL, self-hosted Heebo and aligned tabular numbers.
White summaries, tables and plots with subtle boundaries and gently rounded panels.
Stable slate navigation, petrol actions and functional green, amber and red states.
A domain-aware site ledger, measured activity bars, catalog search and responsive credential list/detail.
dos: **Do** keep numbers, dates and controls visible before explanatory copy.
**Do** compose screens from shared components and local surface/status tokens.
**Do** verify desktop and mobile layouts, keyboard focus, 44px targets and readable contrast.
**Do** retain source distinctions, failures and measurement uncertainty in concise Hebrew.
**Do** keep infrastructure graphite and email presentation separately grounded in their source.
donts: **Don't** restore charcoal summaries or plots to the light workspace, square panel rules or a dark login treatment.
**Don't** add decorative animation, gradients, glass, glow, page eyebrows, decorative badges or new visual libraries.
**Don't** repeat metric icons or explanatory paragraphs in each row.
**Don't** imply that an estimate is a confirmed person, a click is an inquiry or a traffic change is a business outcome.
**Don't** introduce tracking or database behavior merely to support a visual redesign.
